title: nethical6/conversation-steganography
claim: nethical6/conversation-steganography — Use LLMs to hide messages inside normal looking conversations
why_good: Uses LLMs to hide secret messages inside normal-looking chat — clever research, but a steganography/evasion tool, not a product.
value: No legitimate business; the use cases (covert channels) are mostly abuse or evasion.
risk: Grey-area (evasion/covert comms); interesting tech, but not investable and easily misused.
pick_reason: The project offers a unique product for secure communication that can be monetized.
